value.account:
WHAT I CHANGED
- New modules: resume_projection_integrity.py (ResumeScopePath, ResumeProjectionIntegrityError, audit_scope, audit_nested_scopes, resolve_reached_call, projection_error_in_chain; re-exports the lineage API), call_frame_retry_lineage.py (index_retry_lineage, CallFrameRetryLineage, RetryFrameMember, next_unused_retry_frame_id), resume_slot_index.py (slot index, resolve_resume_step_id, resolve_call_boundary), resume_loop_progress.py (for_each / repeat_until bookkeeping validation and ResumeProjectionValidationError), resume_root_guard.py (root checksum recheck reasons).
- state_projection.py: enumerate_resume_slots / resolve_resume_step_id / resolve_call_boundary, CallBoundaryProjection.import_alias (filled by lowering). The declared repeat_until maximum is kept in a new WorkflowStateProjection mapping (repeat_until_max_iterations) rather than on IterationStepKeyProjection, so the serialized loop projection that the characterization goldens snapshot does not change.
- state.py: record_workflow_checksum_mismatch / record_resume_projection_integrity_failure edit only status, error, updated_at on the on-disk JSON (so unknown root fields survive); RunState.from_dict/to_dict keep malformed for_each raw so the audit can reject it instead of crashing in load().
- resume.py (CLI): root audit after the checksum precheck and before observability persistence, sessions, process metadata and executor construction; failure exits 1, prints to stderr, persists only the envelope; session close failures are logged instead of replacing the diagnostic.
- executor.py: structural-root guard (checksum recheck then audit_scope) right before the prologue; resume_scope_path; sticky handling in _handle_control_flow (also scans for_each result lists and wrapped causes); first projection error is promoted to the run error in the epilogue; finalization failures are marked supplemental (failure.error is the cleanup's projection error or null). loops.py: for_each stops after an iteration containing a projection error.
- calls.py: reached calls resolve the boundary with one projection.resolve_call_boundary(slot_index, call_step_id), select the callee by the boundary's alias, pick the frame from the validated lineage (never mapping order), check completed frame-id collisions first, then run checksum / bound-input validation, then failed predecessors (checksum + audit_scope + nested audit) and the running member's audit_scope before any child state manager or executor exists. A child projection failure is returned unwrapped instead of call_failed. _is_workflow_lisp_target now reads provenance.frontend_kind.
- Done by helper agents and reviewed by me via their tests: orchestrator/yaml_import_aliases.py + loader hook (duplicate alias / duplicate top-level imports, with line/column), frontend_kind='workflow_lisp' set in the compiler validation path and build_frontend_bundle no longer overwriting it, and observability (report.py) treating the unchanged current_step of a failed run with these error types as pending.
- Docs: specs/state.md section 'Checksum-compatible resume projection integrity'; specs/acceptance/index.md entries 201-206. Tests: tests/test_resume_projection_integrity.py (new), plus tests for the loader, provenance, observability, and new/updated cases in test_resume_command.py and test_subworkflow_calls.py.

TESTS I HAD TO CHANGE (behaviour the spec deliberately changes)
- Characterization tests of the old gap (stale id / ambiguity / callee-local corruption / malformed call_frames / CLI mutation order) now assert fail-closed behaviour. Three resume tests that hand-built current_step without step_id got step ids. The current_step name-mismatch test now expects presentation_slot_mismatch. The lexical-checkpoint loop-drift test now expects invalid_loop_progress. test_adjudicated_provider_runtime changed_candidate_config stubs the root checksum guard (an edited workflow file is now rejected earlier). Two wcc structural goldens gained import_alias. One production adjustment: _is_workflow_lisp_route only trusts frontend_kind when some lowering-schema evidence exists, so raw compiler bundles resumed directly keep their step-granular route.

ALTERNATIVES CONSIDERED / DISCARDED
- Adding max_iterations to IterationStepKeyProjection: discarded because it changes the golden snapshot shape; used a separate projection mapping instead.
- Making audit_scope recurse into every frame: discarded; the spec audits one scope and recursion happens when calls are reached, so only failed predecessors get an explicit nested descent (audit_nested_scopes, not routed through the patched calls.audit_scope name).
- Using the projection method resolve_call_boundary inside the auditor: discarded so that the method is called exactly once per reached call.
- Persisting failures through fail_run / RunState round trip: discarded because it rewrites more than status/error/updated_at and drops unknown root fields.

JUDGEMENT CALLS / NOT COVERED
- Reason precedence is my reading of the spec: an unowned row name with an unknown id is unclaimed_explicit_step_row; an owned name with an unknown id is unknown_explicit_step_id; a known id under another name is presentation_slot_mismatch; steps are audited before current_step before call frames. repeat_until history must be exactly range(current) when active; a missing loop row is tolerated for the exhaustion forms (resume re-runs the step) and exhausted:null is treated as absent. audit_scope returns silently for a non-bundle object (only mock bundles in CLI tests). expected_owner.workflow_file is str(provenance.workflow_path); root scope_path uses state.workflow_file.
- Frame status is limited to completed/failed/running; a 'suspended' frame would be rejected.
- Not done: dashboard/monitor message code still reads a forensic current_step heartbeat (flagged by the observability helper); no tmux orchestrator smoke run or docs/capability matrix update; nothing committed. Full suite: 48 failures vs 47 on the untouched baseline; the extra one is test_logical_deadline_remaining_budget_is_passed_to_candidate_and_evaluator, a timing-based test that failed under -n 16 load and passes alone.
value.summary: Added the checksum-compatible resume projection audit (new `audit_scope` module, lineage indexing, projection resolvers, CLI/executor/call wiring, sticky failure handling, state envelopes), plus the YAML duplicate-alias check, typed Workflow Lisp provenance, forensic status handling and spec/acceptance docs; the full suite has the same 47 failures as the untouched baseline plus one timing-based adjudication test that failed under parallel load and passes alone.
